text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock D after gains may have reduced my exposure too quickly; I should set a reasoned profit-taking plan rather than sell automatically after a rise.","I should evaluate each holding from today’s price and prospects, not let average cost, the pleasure of locking in gains, or the pain of realizing losses drive the decision.","My account has declined over several periods, so I should avoid reactive trades and check that each buy or sale fits my overall risk and diversification plan."]}
